name: ParetoGS
definition: A continuous-budget 3D Gaussian Splatting representation that uses sparse adapted anchors to decode any Gaussian count K without separate optimization, by interpolating shared member parameters and gradually activating entering members.
summary: ParetoGS is a continuous-budget 3D Gaussian Splatting method that decodes any Gaussian count from a single asset using sparse anchors and residual atlases, offering superior low-budget quality without separate optimization.
